svg.title: Notebook: annotating a past paper with the pen on a laptop, Deskmates v2
svg.text: Wednesday 17 May 2023, 10:00 to 12:00 · Time allowed: two hours
(a) Let X₁, …, Xₙ be a random sample from a Poisson
(i) Find the maximum likelihood estimator of λ.
(ii) Show that it attains the Cramér–Rao lower bound.
(b) Construct an approximate 95% confidence interval for λ
(c) Explain what “efficient” means for an estimator.
